prompt: CI job build-api on shop-api went from 3m02s to 10m48s per build right after Dockerfile cleanup PR #412 merged; even README-only commits re-run the 4m32s npm ci step. Registry egress from the runner pool doubled and the build queue is backing up. Restore layer caching so dependency installs stop re-running on every commit.

checkout-svc v2.14.0 moved to the new c7g Graviton nodegroup at 09:20; all 12 pods now CrashLoopBackOff with exec /usr/local/bin/checkout: exec format error. The docker-release CI job for v2.14.0 shows a green multi-arch buildx step, and the same tag runs fine on the old amd64 nodes. Get the arm64 pods running.

Nightly CI push of ml-runtime:2026-07-03 (11GB image; layer 7 alone is 6.4GB of model weights) to harbor.corp.io fails after roughly 18 minutes with unauthorized: authentication required mid-upload, and every retry fails the same way. Smaller service images from the same runner and the same robot account push fine. Unblock tonight's publish.

Rolling deploys of payments-worker v3.2.1 hang: every container takes exactly 30s to stop, then Docker reports it killed, and in-flight jobs are dropped each time — 14 jobs lost on last night's deploy. The app registers a SIGTERM drain handler that logs 'draining' but that line never appears. Make shutdown graceful again.

The image scanner flagged registry image data-etl:1.9.2 (digest sha256:2f8c91) for an embedded AWS access key AKIA2E7NVXQ4 in layer 4, but docker run --rm data-etl:1.9.2 ls /root/.aws says No such file or directory, and the Dockerfile ends with RUN rm -rf /root/.aws. The team wants the finding closed as a false positive. Verify the claim and remediate.

report-gen:latest passed staging validation at 14:05 and was promoted to prod at 14:40; prod immediately threw TypeError: cfg.retries is undefined at config.js:31 — staging never saw one. Both environments deploy the identical tag from registry.corp.io/report-gen, so the release manager insists the images are identical. Explain the divergence and make the deploy reproducible.

Since CI moved to ephemeral runners, the rust-gateway image build takes 11m04s every run: the cargo build --release stage (9m12s) never hits cache even though every job imports registry cache from registry.corp.io/rust-gateway:buildcache. Warm developer machines build the same commit in under a minute. Make the registry cache work on cold runners.

All builds on runner ci-docker-03 fail with write /var/lib/docker/buildkit/...: no space left on device since 05:10; df shows /var/lib/docker at 98% of its 240GB. A nightly cron runs docker image prune -f and its 02:00 run reported success. Six teams' builds are queued behind this host. Restore capacity and stop the recurrence.

media-svc v5.0.0 added USER 1000 hardening; in the prod compose stack the container now exits 1 at boot with EACCES: permission denied, open '/app/uploads/.tmp-88123'. We rebuilt with RUN chown -R 1000:1000 /app/uploads and redeployed — identical failure. v4 images run fine. Get v5 writing to /app/uploads.

search-api v8.1 containers on the swarm restart every ~2 minutes: task shutdown: unhealthy events since the 07:40 rollout. App logs show clean startups, v8.0 was stable for months, and /healthz returns 200 whenever we curl it by hand. Stop the restart loop without rolling back.

web-frontend builds regressed from about 3m45s to 6m29s this week; BuildKit spends most of that before the first stage even starts. Builds run on a remote builder over the office VPN, and the regression landed the same day the design team merged the public/models asset drop. CI cost alerts fired twice. Make builds fast again.

Security ordered rebuilds for the openssl fix that landed upstream in python:3.12-slim on 2026-07-01. CI rebuilt etl-worker this morning, yet Trivy still flags CVE-2026-41011 in the base layer. The same Dockerfile built on a laptop scans clean. CI pulls bases through mirror.corp.io, a registry pull-through cache. Get CI building on the patched base.

Sec team flagged glibc CVE-2026-30177 in api-gateway:prod. We rebuilt with docker build --no-cache on builder bd-legacy-01 and pushed 4.2.9, but the scanner immediately re-flagged the same glibc version in the new image. Upstream debian:12-slim was patched weeks ago. Explain why the rebuild didn't help and fix it.

notifications-svc v2.3.0 in prod posts every webhook to the compiled-in default http://localhost:8080/hook and gets connection refused — 3,100 undelivered notifications since 06:00. CI passes --build-arg WEBHOOK_BASE_URL=https://hooks.corp.io on every release and the build log shows the value plainly in the build command. Diagnose the configuration plumbing and restore webhook delivery.
